lines.text: SEO comes down to three things: a healthy website, relevant content, and backlinks from other sites. Ryze does all three.
Connect your website, and Google Search Console.
Ryze audits your top three hundred pages every week: broken links, page speed, titles, schema, sitemap. It fixes what's broken when you approve.
To move you up, Ryze picks keywords carefully: people really search them, they match what you sell, and the competition is low enough to beat.
It also finds searches where you already show up on Google, but don't have a page yet.
For AI search, it looks at your competitors first, then builds the questions buyers ask ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity.
It asks them on every refresh, and shows who gets named, you or a competitor, and which sources they cite.
Then it writes the articles: listicles, comparisons, alternatives, answers to real questions. Each one gets a summary, an FAQ, images, and links to your own pages.
Every article is scored out of a hundred, on nine checks, from structure and links to meta tags and schema.
Then it publishes them to your site on schedule, up to ninety a month. Or you approve each one yourself.
Backlinks come from the Ryze Backlink Exchange. Websites that don't compete with you link to each other in chains, and your site gets new backlinks every month.
[warm] Do this for three months, and your traffic grows. Start today.
